jutsu.name: Eruption: Three-Plank Line
jutsu.description: Strikes the ground its omen marked.

jutsu.name: Twin Kunai
jutsu.battleDescription: %user snaps two kunai from their sleeves and releases them in a single motion. They fly side by side and strike %target almost as one.

jutsu.name: Chart Mark
jutsu.description: Marks a target on the chart; the crew converge on it.

jutsu.name: Omen: Three-Plank Line
jutsu.description: A warning mark. Whatever it marks is struck on the caster's next turn.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user sights down a short red line toward %target.

jutsu.name: Split Image
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B06. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user weaves the Ram seal and presses chakra into the earth at their side. A second %user rises from it, identical down to the dust on their tabi, and steps into the fight.

jutsu.name: Keelbind
jutsu.description: Chakra moorings strike and anchor the target while draining health, chakra, and stamina over time.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user lashes chakra moorings at %target, the lines closing around their footing as a draining pulse runs through each strand.

jutsu.name: Maw of the Deep
jutsu.description: Core Horror signature (Omen: Last Light): black water and teeth everywhere but the stars; Exposed Seam, x3 damage taken for 1 round.

effects.description: Extra raw damage from specific things

jutsu.battleDescription: %user sinks into the deck, and black water and teeth rise from every plank. The mass splits open along a glowing seam.

jutsu.battleDescription: %user stamps once, and the floor swells red in patches.

jutsu.battleDescription: %user plants their feet, twists from the hips, and puts their whole weight behind one heavy strike. It lands on %target with a crack that echoes across the field.

jutsu.name: Undertow
jutsu.description: The deck turns to a rip tide beneath the target and drags them in.
jutsu.battleDescription: The planks under %target heave like a rip tide, and %user drags them in across the deck.

jutsu.name: Omen: Three Lights
jutsu.description: A warning mark. Whatever it marks is struck on the caster's next turn.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user raises both hands, and the whole field darkens red. Three points of skyglass light remain.

jutsu.name: The Core Rebuilds
jutsu.description: The Core pours fresh skyglass into the Horror's wounds and seals them over.
jutsu.battleDescription: Skyglass floods the cracks in %user's body, and the wounds seal over with a low, rising hum.

jutsu.battleDescription: %user presses a palm to the floor, and a ring of red cracks opens around them.
